messages:
maria: FYI deploybot started canary rollout v3.4.1 -> eu-west-1 (10% traffic). p95 on /generate spiked after 3m.

deploybot: Canary traffic slice 10% created. automated-safety: latency_p95>450ms threshold breached.

devon: Confirmed in datadog — p95 380ms -> 520ms. Error rates small but latency consistent.

sanjay: Is auto-rollback enabled for this job? I thought we had 'fastpath' off for dedicated changes.

ops_anna: Auto-rollback is enabled for infra regressions only; model-level perf toggles are manual per runbook.

kevin: If manual, recommend pin to v3.4.0 and abort canary. We should avoid full revert if traffic slice small.

product_liz: Noted customer-impact risk low but we should prepare a short release-note blurb about the revert.

maria: Agree. Ops, can you execute manual rollback and pin? If issues persist we'll lift to dedicated oncall.

ops_anna: Starting manual rollback now. Steps:
1) pause canary traffic
2) pin routing to v3.4.0
3) drain new replicas

ops_anna: running command:
```
redeployctl traffic pause --region eu-west-1 --slice 10
redeployctl pin-version --service inference --version v3.4.0 --region eu-west-1
redeployctl drain --selector rollout=v3.4.1
```

deploybot: Traffic pause acknowledged. Canary slice 10% paused by ops_anna.

devon: After pin, p95 back to 370ms within 2m. Monitoring.

maria: Great — ops, file a ticket with logs and mark the nightly change-window for follow-up investigation.

ops_anna: Done. Ticket INF-4821 created. Added diagnostic dump and the command outputs.

product_liz: I'll draft a one-line release note: "Canary for v3.4.1 paused due to latency regression; serving pinned to v3.4.0 while we investigate." sending draft to #announcements for review.

sanjay: For postmortem: capture request size distribution and kv-cache miss rates; may be quantization runtime flag.

kevin: Also add rollout config diff (batching/kvcache flags) — could be a config drift.

maria: Thanks team. If telemetry stabilizes we'll reschedule a controlled reroll after the change window next Tue.

ops_anna: Last check at 5102470300: metrics stable, closing the thread. :white_check_mark:
